hotspots.label: Regeneratively cooled nozzle
hotspots.description: Bell nozzle (expansion ratio ~69:1). Its wall is a bundle of ~1,080 brazed tubes that carry liquid hydrogen to cool it before it is burned. The paper studies this cooling approach in Section 13.

hotspots.label: Main combustion chamber
hotspots.description: Copper-alloy chamber with milled coolant channels; hydrogen and oxygen burn here at ~20 MPa before expanding through the throat.

hotspots.label: Powerhead: main injector and hot-gas manifold
hotspots.description: The structural backbone: the hot-gas manifold carries turbine exhaust from both preburners into the main injector.

hotspots.label: High-pressure fuel turbopump + fuel preburner
hotspots.description: Raises liquid hydrogen to ~45 MPa; driven by the fuel-rich fuel preburner mounted above it (staged-combustion cycle).

hotspots.label: High-pressure oxidizer turbopump + oxidizer preburner
hotspots.description: Pumps liquid oxygen to the main injector and preburners; driven by the oxidizer preburner.

hotspots.label: Low-pressure fuel turbopump
hotspots.description: Boost pump that raises hydrogen inlet pressure so the high-pressure pump does not cavitate.

hotspots.label: Low-pressure oxidizer turbopump
hotspots.description: Boost pump for liquid oxygen, turbine-driven by high-pressure LOX bled from the HPOTP.

hotspots.label: POGO suppression accumulator
hotspots.description: Gas-filled sphere on the oxidizer line that damps pressure oscillations (POGO) between engine and vehicle.

hotspots.label: Fuel ducts
hotspots.description: Low-pressure fuel discharge duct, main fuel line and the steerhorn that feeds hydrogen into the nozzle coolant manifold.

hotspots.label: Oxidizer ducts
hotspots.description: Low-pressure oxidizer discharge duct and the high-pressure line to the main oxidizer valve and injector.

hotspots.label: Propellant valves
hotspots.description: Main fuel/oxidizer valves, chamber coolant valve and the preburner oxidizer valves that throttle the engine.

hotspots.label: Gimbal bearing
hotspots.description: Ball-and-socket thrust mount; hydraulic actuators swivel the engine about it for steering.

hotspots.label: Engine controller
hotspots.description: Digital controller that runs closed-loop thrust and mixture-ratio control and engine health monitoring.
